column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name, not by delta: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES=<pg> go test ./engine/ -run TestFailWorkflowNilQueryStatePreservesThePriorSegment -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' | grep -c '"Test":' reports exactly 2. Guards cleat#2520's FailWorkflow half: the UPDATE is COALESCE($N, query_state) on Postgres, COALESCE(?, query_state) on MySQL, COALESCE(@pN, query_state) on MSSQL -- three separately written statements, and a postgres-only run cannot vouch for the other two binding a real SQL NULL the same way.
